note: The closed, machine-readable contract for the provenance harvester's stored shapes. Python (tools/provenance/src/provenance/contract.py) and Node (site/lib/provenance-contract.mjs) validate against THIS file with hand-rolled validators; no JSON Schema dependency. Type language: see 'typelang'. Every 'obj' is closed (extra keys invalid) and every listed field is required (nullable where 'null': true) unless listed under 'optional_fields'. Patterns are written without anchors and always FULL-match (Python re.fullmatch; JS new RegExp('^(?:'+p+')$')). Content identity and every stored digest (evidence_ref.raw_sha256, receipt parity, the ingest's identical-vs-conflict test, TreeBuilder.add on a .json.gz path) are defined on the DECOMPRESSED canonical JSON bytes; gzip bytes are storage only and may differ across zlib builds.

typelang.str: string; optional 're' (full-match, ASCII-only pattern) and 'max' (an upper bound on the number of Unicode CODE POINTS — Python len(s), JS [...s].length, never JS s.length)
typelang.int: integer (never a bool, never a float); optional 'min'/'max' inclusive
typelang.list: array of 'of'; optional 'max' length; 'unique' — no two elements with the same canonical JSON (sorted keys at every depth, no whitespace: Python json.dumps(v, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False); Node must stringify with recursively sorted keys, never plain JSON.stringify); 'sorted' — ascending, comparing ints numerically and strings by Unicode CODE POINT (Python '<'; Node must compare [...a] against [...b] code point by code point, never the default UTF-16 sort or localeCompare); a 'sorted' list is always homogeneous (all ints or all strings)
typelang.obj: closed object: exactly the keys of 'fields' (+ any of 'optional_fields'); all 'fields' required
typelang.open: object that must carry 'fields' (typed) and may carry any other key (opaque complete API objects)
typelang.map: object whose keys full-match 'key' and whose values are 'of'; optional 'max' entries
typelang.any: any JSON value (only inside receipt jobs[].steps)
typelang.kindfields: the closed field set field_sets[<sibling 'kind' value>] (event@1 'fields')
typelang.null: on any type: null is also accepted
typelang.tag: derivation tag (documentation only): D deterministic, J join, W window, N not-derivable; 'D|W' = depends on the source

sort_key: events sort ascending by (ts, precision_rank.index(ts_precision), source_rank.index(id prefix before the first ':'), numeric github id = the first all-digit ':'-segment after the prefix or 0, sub-index = the last ':'-segment if all-digit and not the github id else 0, id); see canonical.event_sort_key
